hero_h1: The Football Manager mods the community actually uses
hero_p: Databases, graphics, skins and more, gathered and tested by fans. Pick a category or search by name.
howto_h2: How to install mods in 4 steps
howto_1: Download the file from the mod page and unzip it (7-Zip or WinRAR).
howto_2: Copy the install path with the button on the mod page.
howto_3: Paste the files into that game folder (create it if it doesn't exist).
howto_4: Done. In FM26 and later, graphics load on their own (in FM24, reload the skin in Preferences). Databases are chosen when you start a new save.
